title: SLB Brings Industrial Expertise to Growing AI Data Center Market
summary: Amy Chua discusses SLB’s data center opportunity on CNBC’s Mad Money
body_markdown:
## Modular design and cooling technology support faster, more reliable data center delivery


SLB’s engineering and manufacturing capabilities are helping customers meet growing demand for AI data center infrastructure, Amy Chua, senior vice president of Data Centers, told Jim Cramer on CNBC’s Mad Money.


Chua discussed how modular design helps accelerate delivery while maintaining quality and reliability, and how the proposed Kelvion acquisition would expand SLB’s offering with thermal management technologies.


The interview also highlighted SLB’s role in Meta’s data center project in Canada and its work with NVIDIA on modular infrastructure design.


Watch the full interview below for Chua’s perspective on customer demand and SLB’s growing role in AI infrastructure.
